title: EC Library NDE customization settings
description: Every value in config/global.json (all views) and config/views/<view>.json (overrides for one view). Per-view files may contain any subset of the same keys; they are deep-merged over global.json at build time (objects merge, arrays and scalars replace). Descriptions double as help text in the settings UI.

defaultLang.title: Default language
defaultLang.description: Used when the current UI language has no entry in a localised value.

userInfo.title: Signed-in user details
userInfo.description: How the module reads the patron's details from Primo (used to prefill forms and the chat).

jwtStorageKey.title: JWT storage key
jwtStorageKey.description: sessionStorage key where Primo keeps the session JWT. Do not change unless Ex Libris renames it.

jwtNameClaim.title: JWT name claim
jwtNameClaim.description: Claim in the JWT payload that holds the display name (EC: displayName).

endpoint.title: Personal details endpoint
endpoint.description: Private Primo REST path returning the patron's contact details. {vid} and {lang} are substituted at call time.

lastSearch.title: Pick up where you left off
lastSearch.description: Remembers the last results page per view and shows a link on the landing page.

storageKeyPrefix.title: localStorage key prefix
storageKeyPrefix.description: The view id is appended, so each view remembers its own search.

resultsPath.title: Results route
resultsPath.description: Router path of the results page, relative to /nde.

homePath.title: Landing route
homePath.description: Router path of the landing page, where the link is rendered.

stripParams.title: Parameters not to store
stripParams.description: Query parameters removed before saving (dev switches, cache-busters).

maxAgeDays.title: Forget after (days)
maxAgeDays.description: A stored search older than this is discarded.

pageLabel.title: Page indication
pageLabel.description: Shown after the search terms when the patron was beyond the first page, e.g. (page 4). {n} is replaced by the page number. Empty English = no page indication.

defaultPageSize.title: Results per page (default)
defaultPageSize.description: NDE's default page size. The results URL only carries an offset (offset=30), so the page number is offset / page size + 1. When the patron picks another page size it is detected from the number of results on screen; this value is used until then.

fullDisplayPath.title: Full record route
fullDisplayPath.description: Router path of the full record page, relative to /nde. Opening a record there marks it as the last viewed one.

lastViewedLabel.title: 'Last viewed' label
lastViewedLabel.description: Shown in the results list on the record the patron opened last; the list also scrolls to it when they return through the landing-page link. Empty English = feature off.

askALibrarian.title: Ask a librarian
askALibrarian.description: The modal that opens the LibAnswers question form instead of leaving the page.

triggerUrlPrefixes.title: Trigger link prefixes
triggerUrlPrefixes.description: Any link whose href starts with one of these opens the modal. Prefix match (language variants and query strings included).

formfillScriptUrl.title: Prefill helper script
formfillScriptUrl.description: URL of libanswers.script.js on Europa. Loaded before the widget; its CSS is resolved relative to it.

widgetId.title: Widget id per language
widgetId.description: LibAnswers question-form widget id. Empty en = modal disabled (links behave normally).

prefillFromUser.title: Prefill from user
prefillFromUser.description: LibAnswers form field name → patron property. Field names come from the rendered form (pname, pemail, custom5, …).

prefillStatic.title: Static prefill
prefillStatic.description: Field name → fixed value, always applied (e.g. a hidden 'source' field).

context.title: Context block
context.description: Text appended to the question with what the patron was looking at.

field.title: Target field
field.description: Form textarea that receives the block.

titleSelector.title: Record title selector
titleSelector.description: CSS selector of the record title on the full-display page.

marker.title: Marker line
marker.description: Written first; the patron types above it.

errorLabel.title: Error text
errorLabel.description: Shown when the widget could not be loaded; followed by a link to the real page.

resetOnClose.title: Reset form on close
resetOnClose.description: Discard the form when the modal closes so every open starts empty.

hideFields.title: Hidden form fields
hideFields.description: Form field names whose row is hidden (typically set per view). A hidden required field must be filled via static prefill instead.

formCssPath.title: Form stylesheet path
formCssPath.description: Package-relative CSS injected into the widget's shadow root; per-view assets overlay applies. Missing file = ignored.

hash.title: Widget hash
hash.description: From the LibChat embed code (hash= parameter). Empty = no chat on this view.

signedInOnly.title: Only for signed-in users
signedInOnly.description: Ticked: guests do not see the chat button (LibChat is not even loaded for them); it appears as soon as the patron signs in and disappears again on sign-out. Unticked: everyone sees it.

floatButtonSelector.title: Floating button selector
floatButtonSelector.description: CSS selector of LibChat's button; only change if LibAnswers changes its markup.

network.title: EC network check
network.description: Tells whether the visitor is on the EC network by requesting a URL that only answers there. Used to show/hide content (data-ec-network="ec" / "external" in homepage, header and footer HTML — e.g. the lock after the Intracomm link in the footer) and by components. Runs once per browser tab. Outside the network, while checking, or when switched off, visitors count as external.

pingUrl.title: Ping URL
pingUrl.description: Technical. Must only be reachable from the EC network. Any answer counts as 'on the EC network'.

timeoutMs.title: Timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: No answer within this time = external.

kiosk.title: Reading room PCs (kiosk mode)
kiosk.description: Kiosk mode is switched on per PC by opening a view once with &ec_kiosk=1 in the URL (and off with &ec_kiosk=0). On such a PC no feature stores anything in the browser (no 'Pick up where you left off', no remembered account counts, no 'don't show again'), and the tab is reset after a period without activity.

idleMinutes.title: Reset after (minutes without activity)
idleMinutes.description: After this many minutes without mouse/keyboard/touch activity the session is cleared (the patron is signed out in this browser) and the home page is reloaded; a warning with a countdown appears one minute before. 0 = no automatic reset. Also shown in the reading room badge in the header.

warningTitle.title: Warning title
warningTitle.description: Title of the 'are you still there?' dialog shown one minute before the reset.

warningText.title: Warning text
warningText.description: {s} is replaced by the seconds left.

welcomeMessage.title: Welcome message
welcomeMessage.description: Modal shown when a patron opens the view. Global = the shared message for all views; a view can override the text (its own message) or 'Show the message' (switch it off). Any change to the title or text counts as a new message and is shown to everyone again, including patrons who ticked 'don't show again'.

enabled.title: Show the message
enabled.description: Untick to switch the welcome message off (here: for all views; on a view tab: for that view only).

title.title: Title
title.description: Heading in the blue bar of the modal.

html.title: Message (HTML)
html.description: Body of the message as HTML markup, per language (English is used when a language is empty; empty English = no message). Allowed: normal markup, links, images, class attributes. Removed on display: scripts, inline style attributes, data-* attributes.

rememberDays.title: Remember 'don't show again' for (days)
rememberDays.description: How long a patron who ticked the box is left alone. 180 = about 6 months. A changed message is shown regardless.

libraryOnTheGo.title: Library on the Go
libraryOnTheGo.description: Badge on records of the 'Library on the Go' digital collection (titles readable outside the EC network with EU Login), at the end of the record's top line in the results list and the full record, with an (i) button that opens an explanation.

collectionId.title: Collection ID
collectionId.description: Alma ID of the Library on the Go collection — the number after $$D in the record's PNX field control.colldiscovery, also visible in the URL when filtering on the collection (facet=digital_collection,include,<ID>).

color.title: Badge colour
color.description: Any CSS colour, e.g. #00727a. Used for the text and the (i) icon.

infoButtonLabel.title: (i) button label
infoButtonLabel.description: Read by screen readers; not visible.

dialogHtml.title: Dialog text (HTML)
dialogHtml.description: Explanation shown when the (i) is clicked, as HTML markup per language (English is used when a language is empty). Scripts, inline style and data-* attributes are removed on display.

pnxEndpoint.title: PNX endpoint (fallback)
pnxEndpoint.description: Technical. Used only when the record data cannot be read from the NDE component: Primo endpoint returning one record's PNX. Placeholders: {recordId}, {vid}, {lang}.

noResultsHelp.title: No results help
noResultsHelp.description: Help block shown under NDE's 'No records found' message: the library's own ways out (search guide, Ask a librarian, ...).

html.title: Text (HTML)
html.description: Body as HTML markup per language (English is used when a language is empty; empty English = no block). A link to the Ask-a-librarian page opens the modal. Scripts, inline style and data-* attributes are removed on display.

loansDue.title: Loans due soon
loansDue.description: Line on the landing page for signed-in patrons with the number of overdue loans and loans due soon, linking to the library card. Only on views whose landing page contains the data-ec-loans-due markup.

overdueLabel.title: Text for overdue loans
overdueLabel.description: {n} is replaced by the number of overdue loans.

dueSoonLabel.title: Text for loans due soon
dueSoonLabel.description: {n} = number of loans, {days} = the number of days above.

testWithPastLoans.title: TEST ONLY: use past loans
testWithPastLoans.description: Reads the loan history instead of the active loans, so every past loan counts as overdue and the line can be seen without having an active loan. Never leave this ticked in production.

endpoint.title: Loans endpoint
endpoint.description: Technical. Primo endpoint the library card itself uses. Placeholders: {type} (active/history), {lang}, {inst}, {patronId}, {vid}.

accountCounts.title: Account counts on the landing page
accountCounts.description: Links with the number of loans, saved records and saved searches on the landing page (items at 0 are hidden). Shown to guests too, with the numbers remembered from the last signed-in visit on that browser. Only on views whose landing page contains the data-ec-account-counts markup.

ariaLabel.title: Screen-reader name of the row
ariaLabel.description: Read out before the links, e.g. "Your library account".

welcomeLabel.title: Line above the counts
welcomeLabel.description: Shown above the links whenever they are shown (e.g. "You have:"). Empty = no line. A container with data-ec-account-counts-welcome="off" never shows it.

label.title: Text
label.description: "singular|plural" — {n} is the number, e.g. "{n} loan|{n} loans".

route.title: NDE page
route.description: Technical. NDE route the link opens, e.g. account/loans; vid and lang are added automatically.

label.title: Text
label.description: "singular|plural" — {n} is the number, e.g. "{n} loan|{n} loans".

route.title: NDE page
route.description: Technical. NDE route the link opens, e.g. account/favorites; vid and lang are added automatically.

label.title: Text
label.description: "singular|plural" — {n} is the number, e.g. "{n} loan|{n} loans".

route.title: NDE page
route.description: Technical. NDE route the link opens, e.g. account/savedSearches; vid and lang are added automatically.

testWithPastLoans.title: TEST ONLY: count past loans
testWithPastLoans.description: Counts the loan history instead of the active loans, so the loans link can be seen without having an active loan. Never leave this ticked in production.

printReturnLabel.title: Print return label
printReturnLabel.description: Link under each active loan — and, when switched on below, under past (returned) loans too. Only on views whose mappings mount the component.

labelPagePath.title: Label page path
labelPagePath.description: Package-relative path of the label page.

codePaths.title: Library code property paths
codePaths.description: Dot paths tried on the loan host component to find the library code, in order.

returnedMarker.title: Returned-loan marker
returnedMarker.description: CSS selector present only on returned (history) loan rows. Those rows get no label unless 'Also show on past loans' is ticked.

showOnPastLoans.title: Also show on past loans
showOnPastLoans.description: Tick to show the link on returned (history) loans as well — handy for testing without an active loan. Those links carry the CSS class ec-print-return-label--returned, so they can still be hidden or styled separately.

resourceSharing.title: Resource sharing request
resourceSharing.description: Force the request format per view and hide the choice (EC views: digital; EU union catalogue: physical).

forceFormat.title: Force format
forceFormat.description: Format applied when the resource-sharing form opens. Empty = leave the choice to the patron.

hideFormatField.title: Hide the Format field
hideFormatField.description: Move the field off screen once forced, so it cannot be changed (it is still submitted).

autoCheckAvailability.title: Re-check availability
autoCheckAvailability.description: Click 'Check availability' after forcing the format, as the VE script did.

formatFieldSelector.title: Format field selector
formatFieldSelector.description: CSS selector of the Format field inside the dialog. Only change if NDE changes its markup.

values.title: Candidate values
values.description: Values Alma may use for this format in the form definition (matched case-insensitively).

labels.title: Candidate labels
labels.description: Displayed labels in any language, as a secondary match.

position.title: Position in the option list
position.description: 0-based index in Alma's fixed order (Physical, Digital, Photocopy) — the last-resort match.
